newsitem.title: USA: USDA begins Wetlands Reserve Program sign-up.
newsitem.headline: USDA begins Wetlands Reserve Program sign-up.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Tuesday that beginning October 1 and continuing for an indefinite period, landowners wishing to enroll eligible acres in USDA's Wetlands Reserve Program (WRP) can do so at any time.
Glickman said that through the WRP, the department has restored about 325,000 acres of wetlands and said the goal is to restore another 650,000 acres over the next six years.

To be eligible for the program, land must be restorable and provide significant wetland and wildlife habitat. The program offers landowners three options: permanent easements, 30-year easements and restoration cost-share agreements of a minimum 10-year duration.
